statements.stack.toList_push:
theorem Stack.toList_push (s : Stack) (time count : Nat) :
    (s.push time count).toList = s.toList ++ List.replicate count time
statements.stack.takeLast_some:
theorem Stack.takeLast_some (s : Stack) (n : Nat) (moved : List Run) (rest : Stack)
    (h : s.takeLast n = some (moved, rest)) :
    rest.toList ++ expand moved = s.toList ∧ (expand moved).length = n
statements.stack.takeLast_none:
theorem Stack.takeLast_none (s : Stack) (n : Nat) (h : s.takeLast n = none) :
    s.toList.length < n
statements.5a.capLevel_eq:
theorem capLevel_eq (ws : List Nat) (k : Nat) (hk : k ≤ 5) :
    capLevel ws k = 1999 * tailSum ws k / (10000 - 1999 * k)
statements.5a.waterFill_spec:
theorem waterFill_spec (ws : List Nat) (hs : ws.Pairwise (· ≥ ·)) (hlen : 6 ≤ ws.length) :
    (waterFillLoop ws 5 0).1 ≤ 5 ∧
      (∀ i (hi : i < ws.length), (ws[i] > (waterFillLoop ws 5 0).2 ↔ i < (waterFillLoop ws 5 0).1)) ∧
      (waterFillLoop ws 5 0).2 * (10000 - 1999 * (waterFillLoop ws 5 0).1) ≤
        1999 * tailSum ws (waterFillLoop ws 5 0).1
statements.5a.level_bound:
theorem level_bound (ws : List Nat) (hs : ws.Pairwise (· ≥ ·)) (hlen : 6 ≤ ws.length) :
    10000 * (waterFillLoop ws 5 0).2 ≤ 1999 * (ws.map (min · (waterFillLoop ws 5 0).2)).sum
statements.5a.cap_bound:
theorem cap_bound (parties : List (Nat × Nat)) (h6 : 6 ≤ (sortedWeights parties).length) :
    ∀ p ∈ parties, 10000 * counted parties p.2 ≤ 1999 * countedTotal parties
statements.5a.largestRemainder_sum:
theorem largestRemainder_sum {α : Type} (a : Nat) (share : α → Nat) (id : α → Nat)
    (entries : List α) (hS : 0 < (entries.map share).sum) :
    ((largestRemainder a share id entries).map (·.2)).sum = a
statements.5a.largestRemainder_slice:
theorem largestRemainder_slice {α : Type} (a : Nat) (share : α → Nat) (id : α → Nat)
    (entries : List α) (hS : 0 < (entries.map share).sum) :
    ∀ x ∈ largestRemainder a share id entries,
      a * share x.1 / (entries.map share).sum ≤ x.2 ∧
        x.2 ≤ a * share x.1 / (entries.map share).sum + 1
statements.5a.groupSplit_sum:
theorem groupSplit_sum (G : Nat) (ms : List (Account × Bool)) (hG : G ≤ (ms.map (·.1.weight)).sum) :
    ((groupSplit G ms).map (·.2)).sum = G
statements.5a.partySlices_sum:
theorem partySlices_sum (c : Nat) (party : Party) (hk : party.HasKeys) (hc : c ≤ party.weight) :
    ((partySlices c party).map (·.2)).sum = c
statements.5a.roster_total:
theorem roster_total (r : Roster) (hk : ∀ x ∈ r, x.2.HasKeys) :
    r.W = countedTotal r.weights
statements.5a.roster_cap:
theorem roster_cap (r : Roster) (hk : ∀ x ∈ r, x.2.HasKeys)
    (h6 : 6 ≤ (sortedWeights r.weights).length) :
    ∀ x ∈ r, 10000 * ((partySlices (counted r.weights x.2.weight) x.2).map (·.2)).sum ≤ 1999 * r.W
statements.5a.live_hasKeys: theorem live_hasKeys (r : Roster) : ∀ x ∈ r.live, x.2.HasKeys
statements.5a.roster_cap_live:
theorem roster_cap_live (r : Roster) (h6 : 6 ≤ (sortedWeights r.live.weights).length) :
    ∀ x ∈ r.live,
      10000 * ((partySlices (counted r.live.weights x.2.weight) x.2).map (·.2)).sum ≤ 1999 * r.live.W
statements.5b.steps_keep_exclusions:
theorem steps_keep_exclusions (incs : List Incident) (fs : List Fault) (c : Nat)
    (h : excluded incs c) : excluded (fs.foldl step incs) c
statements.5b.steps_prefix:
theorem steps_prefix (incs : List Incident) (fs : List Fault) :
    ∃ extra, fs.foldl step incs = incs ++ extra
statements.5b.step_joins:
theorem step_joins (incs : List Incident) (f : Fault) (i : Incident) (hi : i ∈ incs)
    (hn : f.named < i.stop + margin) : step incs f = incs
statements.5b.step_during_exclusion:
theorem step_during_exclusion (incs : List Incident) (f : Fault) (i : Incident) (hi : i ∈ incs)
    (hp : f.proof < i.stop) : step incs f = incs
statements.5b.step_opens_after:
theorem step_opens_after (incs : List Incident) (f : Fault) (j : Incident)
    (hj : step incs f = incs ++ [j]) : ∀ i ∈ incs, i.stop + margin + 1 ≤ j.start
statements.5b.ladder_values:
theorem ladder_values (earlier : List Incident) (p : Nat) :
    ladder earlier p = 30 ∨ ladder earlier p = 365 ∨ ladder earlier p = 1461
statements.5b.batch_order:
theorem batch_order (incs : List Incident) (p : Nat) (fs gs : List Fault) (hperm : fs.Perm gs)
    (hp : ∀ f ∈ fs, f.proof = p) : fs.foldl step incs = gs.foldl step incs
statements.5b.pruned_recompute_shortens:
theorem pruned_recompute_shortens :
    excluded (pruneExample.foldl step []) 800 ∧ ¬ excluded ([(⟨700, 699, 2⟩ : Fault)].foldl step []) 800
statements.5b.prune_excluded:
theorem prune_excluded (now c : Nat) (hc : now ≤ c) (incs : List Incident) :
    excluded (prune now incs) c ↔ excluded incs c
statements.5b.step_prune:
theorem step_prune (now : Nat) (f : Fault) (hp : now ≤ f.proof) (incs : List Incident)
    (hwf : WellFormed incs) : step (prune now incs) f = prune now (step incs f)
statements.5b.steps_prune:
theorem steps_prune (now : Nat) : ∀ (fs : List Fault) (incs : List Incident), (∀ f ∈ fs, now ≤ f.proof) →
    WellFormed incs → fs.foldl step (prune now incs) = prune now (fs.foldl step incs)
statements.5b.run_eq_prune:
theorem run_eq_prune : ∀ (evs : List Event) (incs : List Incident), Timed evs → WellFormed incs →
    evs.foldl Event.apply incs = prune (lastPrune evs) ((faultsOf evs).foldl step incs)
statements.5b.pruning_keeps_exclusions:
theorem pruning_keeps_exclusions (evs : List Event) (ht : Timed evs) (c : Nat) (hc : lastPrune evs ≤ c) :
    excluded (evs.foldl Event.apply []) c ↔ excluded ((faultsOf evs).foldl step []) c
statements.5b.pruning_keeps_records:
theorem pruning_keeps_records (evs : List Event) (ht : Timed evs) :
    ∀ i ∈ evs.foldl Event.apply [], i ∈ (faultsOf evs).foldl step []
